claim: RAG can incorporate the latest documents in a few minutes.

evidence.quote: RAG can incorporate the latest documents in a few minutes.
evidence.source_title: Comparing Retrieval Augmented Generation and fine-tuning - AWS Prescriptive Guidance

claim: Fine-tuning can take a few hours to days, depending on the model size.

evidence.quote: Fine-tuning can take a few hours to days, depending on the size of the model. Therefore, it not be a good solution if your custom documents change frequently.
evidence.source_title: Comparing Retrieval Augmented Generation and fine-tuning - AWS Prescriptive Guidance

claim: RAG does not modify the underlying LLM.

evidence.quote: RAG does this without modifying the underlying LLM, while fine-tuning requires adjusting the weights and parameters of an LLM.

claim: Fine-tuning adjusts an LLM’s weights and parameters.

evidence.quote: RAG does this without modifying the underlying LLM, while fine-tuning requires adjusting the weights and parameters of an LLM.

claim: Fine-tuning involves additional rounds of training on a smaller, domain-specific data set.

evidence.quote: Fine-tuning a generative AI model means taking a general-purpose model, such as Claude 2 from Anthropic, Command from Cohere, or Llama 2 from Meta; giving it additional rounds of training on a smaller, domain-specific data set; and adjusting the model’s parameters based on this training.
evidence.source_title: RAG vs. Fine-Tuning: How to Choose

claim: RAG responses provide a reference to the information source.

evidence.quote: In its response, a RAG model provides a reference to the information source.
evidence.source_title: Comparing Retrieval Augmented Generation and fine-tuning - AWS Prescriptive Guidance

claim: Fine-tuned model responses do not provide a source reference.

evidence.quote: Fine-tuned models do not provide a reference to the source in their responses.
evidence.source_title: Comparing Retrieval Augmented Generation and fine-tuning - AWS Prescriptive Guidance
